description: This file defines the EventRepository interface, extending JpaRepository for Event entities with UUIDs, and includes a custom query method to find events overlapping a given time interval.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing Event entities, with a custom method to find overlapping events based on start and end times.

methods.name: findOverlapping
methods.description: Fetches events from the database that overlap with a specified time interval, ordered by start time.
